messages:
jules: FYI Orion POC failing CI - their validator rejects fncall JSON when trade_id is null. They pasted a failing example. Can we swarm?

maddy: paste sample pls and any logs you have.

jules: sample:
{
  "trade_id": null,
  "amount": 2500
}

infra-bot: log snippet: [2026-03-21T17:05:12Z] req=zz99 model=redwood-2-stream mode=json error=schema_violation field=trade_id; rate_limit=429 Retry-After=2

maddy: likely streaming boundary or token truncation causing literal null or empty value. Also seeing client retries causing quota spikes.

rob: short-term options: 1) non-streaming validation endpoint for CI runs 2) enable json_mode.stable_key_order=true + json_mode.drop_nulls=true for POC route 3) advise client to implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After. Note: drop_nulls masks missing data.

maddy: pushing canary now. infra-bot: config-change by maddy for route/orion-poc {"json_mode":{"stable_key_order":true,"drop_nulls":true},"streaming":false} rolling to canary

infra-bot: canary check: 15 validation runs, 0 schema_violations. No 429s in canary window.

jules: customer will rerun CI against canary in ~20m. Can we also give them a 1-hour quota bump?

sales-eng: approved temporary qps bump to 500 for 1h.

rob: created INF-10111: "Orion POC - streaming->json nulls + permanent fix" https://go.redwood/infracase/INF-10111

jules: thanks all. I'll update the customer and close after their CI run. :white_check_mark:
